title: Strieber taken to a school for special children in Baja California
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Strieber taken to a school for special children in Baja California, about 1950s at Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: at one point he was taken from the place uh the the the base at Randolph Air Force um to a school for special children in Baja California.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast, relays another part of the childhood story told by Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing encounters with strange beings. According to Jorjani, Strieber says that in the 1950s he was at one point taken from Randolph Air Force Base, a US military base in Texas, to a school for special children in Baja California, Mexico. If true, it would suggest the program he describes reached beyond the base and across the border.
